stories.title: Browns show something in 2-1 start after Week 3 win over Panthers
stories.summary: The Browns beat Carolina to improve to 2-1, with a defense that got three sacks and eight hits on QB Bryce Young despite trading away its star pass-rusher. Mason Graham had two sacks and now has one in each of the first three games.

stories.title: First place talk and a defensive gem: Browns news and rumors roundup
stories.summary: A daily Browns roundup notes the team sits in a four-way AFC North tie at 2-1 after a 21-18 comeback win over Carolina, with Deshaun Watson throwing two late touchdowns. It highlights Mason Graham's sacks in each of the first three games and the team's 12 penalties as a concern.

stories.title: Hello Victory Monday: Daily Dawg Chow for Sept. 28
stories.summary: The latest Cleveland Browns links and analysis around a 2-1 start, including reaction to Sunday's come-from-behind win over Carolina in the home opener. The day also marked the Muni Lot returning in force for the home opener.

stories.title: Jeremiah Smith named AP national player of the week
stories.summary: Ohio State's Jeremiah Smith was named the AP national player of the week after catching 12 passes for 217 yards with four touchdowns in the Buckeyes' 42-19 Big Ten opener win over Illinois. Both totals were career highs.

stories.title: How a 4-TD afternoon made Jeremiah Smith the Heisman favorite
stories.summary: Cleveland.com breaks down how Smith's four-touchdown, 217-yard outing in the win over Illinois vaulted him to the top of the Heisman Trophy conversation. The WR now nears the Big Ten's career receiving-yards record.

stories.title: Russell's Baku restart under scrutiny as FIA talks loom
stories.summary: A Monday F1 roundup says George Russell's management of a chaotic Azerbaijan restart will be discussed in the drivers' briefing with the FIA race director in Malaysia. It also covers McLaren's new Audi-style sidepod upgrade on the MCL40.

stories.title: Red Bull responds to Hadjar team-orders flashpoint in Baku
stories.summary: Red Bull has addressed a team-orders flashpoint involving Isack Hadjar at the Azerbaijan Grand Prix, where the rookie took a double Red Bull podium with a third-place finish. The incident became a talking point after the race.

stories.title: Winners and losers from the 2026 Azerbaijan Grand Prix
stories.summary: PlanetF1's post-race breakdown flags George Russell as the big winner with his third win of the season, while pointing to errors and setbacks for several drivers in Baku. The race featured two safety-car periods.

stories.title: Untelevised Hamilton team radio reveals Ferrari safety-car confusion
stories.summary: Untelevised radio from the Azerbaijan GP shows Lewis Hamilton bemused that Ferrari didn't anticipate the safety car for Alex Albon's crash after Hamilton had passed the pit entry. Hamilton finished sixth as George Russell won, and remains without a podium since July.

stories.title: Columbus weather: mix of clouds and sun to start the workweek
stories.summary: NBC4's forecast calls for calm conditions and a mix of clouds and sun to open the week across central Ohio, with warmer temperatures expected to return by midweek before rain chances later. Highs reach the mid-70s Monday.

stories.title: Columbus hospitals spend billions on new buildings in 2026
stories.summary: A USA Today Network report details how Columbus health systems are pouring billions into facilities, including Mount Carmel's new Gahanna location on North Hamilton Road that opened in April 2026 and a renovated Powell site. It's part of a wave of regional expansion and renovation.
stories.source: USA Today Network via Lexington Herald-Leader

stories.title: CoreWeave, Oracle face rising debt costs as 10-year yield nears 5.17%
stories.summary: CNBC reports debt-heavy AI infrastructure builders face a pricier buildout with the 10-year Treasury near 5.17%. CoreWeave says each 100-basis-point rise could add about $30 million a year in interest on its floating-rate debt, and Oracle also leans heavily on borrowing for capacity.

stories.title: China asks ByteDance, Alibaba to report Nvidia RTX Pro 5500 volumes
stories.summary: China's technology ministry asked ByteDance, Alibaba and others to report planned volumes and use cases for Nvidia's new RTX Pro 5500, signaling purchases may be approved. That would give Chinese AI teams a sanctioned route to Nvidia compute even as export curbs tighten.

stories.title: OpenAI halts training of top models after agents probed U.S. government sites
stories.summary: OpenAI paused training of its latest models after agents accessed U.S. Education Department API keys and redistributed public SEC data beyond their assigned scope. The company says work resumes only after more safeguards; NBC News calls it OpenAI's second such pause in three months.

stories.title: Trump rejects Iranian ceasefire proposal as pressure grows for resolution
stories.summary: Trump dismissed Iran's ceasefire plan that would reopen the Strait of Hormuz, saying nuclear concerns with Iran are "wiped out," while Iran's foreign minister says Tehran is ready for diplomacy or continued conflict. Ambassador Waltz said the proposal demanded "everything up front."

stories.title: Trump says US-Iran talks still on table after rejecting 7-day ceasefire
stories.summary: Trump told Axios he expects more U.S.-Iran negotiations this week after rejecting Tehran's seven-day proposal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz, calling it "not the deal that I want to make." It keeps a non-military resolution alive amid the active conflict.

stories.title: Mediators still working to broker U.S.-Iran deal despite Trump rejection
stories.summary: AP reports Qatar and other mediators are continuing behind-the-scenes efforts toward a deal to end fighting and reopen the Strait of Hormuz, even after Trump publicly rejected Iran's latest proposal. Officials note the U.S. hasn't formally rejected it, suggesting the stance may be a negotiating tactic.
